audit_note: Qualification run/source associations are derived from actual retained source-before/source-after pins. Evidence-publication and byte-audit Root receipts are separately classified in meta-run-associations.json; they are not product qualification runs. Native reports are discovered from complete actual runner argv, including failed reports. The single preserved byte-audit-second prelaunch failure has no child outcome and stays explicitly incomplete. Exact project files, media reports and PCM proofs are retained only when listed as inputs. The builder does not create terminal receipts or run product/build/native commands.
exclusions: Executable bytes and Cargo targets; copied/executed runtime bytes are hash-guarded only.
Native report.html duplicates, unselected PNG sequences and native replay project trees except the exact project files explicitly listed as retained extras.
Unlisted foreign fuzz/Cargo.lock, .claude content and mutable documentation are not recursively collected.

limits.decoded: Bounded gzip-decoded payload bytes plus identity payloads and all metadata; no nested archives.
limits.multimedia: PNG bytes are retained screenshots, not a bound on decoded raster expansion.
limits.raw: Unique retained input bytes plus all metadata.
limits.stored: All published bytes including inventory and other metadata.
